diagnosis: The optimization process is stuck in a local optimum because the skill has achieved a perfect score against the existing evaluation criteria. The optimization loop is not stuck due to the skill's logic or the quality of mutations; it is stuck because of a fundamental tooling failure in the mutation generation process. Consequently, no intelligent mutations are being applied. The system is likely re-evaluating a corrupted or old version of the skill, causing the score to regress from a perfect 36/36 to 18/36 and remain there. The root cause is an environmental or configuration issue, not a flaw in the skill's design or a true local optimum.
